shared_elements: T-shaped monolithic pillar as the decorated surface
animals carved in low relief on the broad face
elongated serpentine or snake-like form descending vertically
relief carving with raised outlined bodies against a plain flat ground
justification: Both are T-shaped pillars whose broad shaft face carries low-relief animals arranged in stacked registers, including a profile quadruped above and a long sinuous descending form below, rendered in the same convention of smooth raised silhouettes with minimal interior detail against a flat ground. B is far richer, with a row of repeated crouching animals across the head, a fringed band, birds and a large long-necked bird below, whereas A shows only a couple of sparse animal figures and no head decoration or repeated frieze.
